messages:
Sara CSM: Heads-up — prepping Summer QBR for Acadia. Need a short, focused rundown on account health + token econ by EOD Thu. Main asks: 1) 90-day spend forecast (tokens + $) 2) Any budget alerts or credit thresholds firing 3) Onboarding enablement status and blockers 4) Renewal risk signals (feature activation, usage churn). Can FinOps + Data help collate?

Liam FinOps: On it. I'll drop a condensed forecast in a sec. Quick note — their embedding volume doubled last week after the new index job, so month-to-month looks noisy.

Ben Data: Pasting quick numbers (rough):
```
Forecast tokens: M1 1.2M, M2 1.5M, M3 1.3M
Forecast $: M1 $9,600, M2 $12,000, M3 $10,400
Drivers: embeddings 62% of tokens, gen calls 28%, rerank 10%
```
Ben Data: Early anomaly: nightly index job retried 3x on 3/14 -> 2x spike. Could be inflating baseline.

Maria Onboarding: From enablement — we finished the API walkthrough last week but feature adoption is low (only 2/6 teams using contextual embeddings). Recommend 30-min deep dive on RAG and caching patterns before the QBR to reduce token waste. I can run it Mon/Tue.

Arjun CS: Renewal risk: current composite score ~47% (medium). Signals: increased token spend w/ low feature adoption, slow MAP engagement, NPS survey pending. Upside: they did opt into Dedicated trial which shows commitment. Need to call out cost optimization opportunities in the QBR — propose showing batching + prefix cache hit impact.

Liam FinOps: Budget alerts — billing-bot flagged a near-threshold: "usage_threshold: 85% of monthly commit" on their retainer. Not urgent but callout in QBR useful. Also note: recommend pricing cadence for embeddings (quantization + batch sizing) could save ~25% unit cost.

billing-bot: Billing alert to #customer-success: Customer Acadia (acct: AC-834) reached 85% of monthly usage commit. Details: https://billing.example/ac-834

Sara CSM: Great context. Action items:
- Liam: finalize the 90-day spend forecast + one-slide sensitivity (best, base, worst) — due Thu EOD.
- Ben: produce a 1-slide usage driver breakdown + anomaly note re index job.
- Maria: schedule 30-min enablement session and send invite to Acadia POCs.
- Arjun: draft renewal risk summary + recommended play (offer optimization audit + 1-month Dedicated pilot expand).

Liam FinOps: Ack — will attach the slide and a short note on assumptions.

Ben Data: I'll annotate the anomaly and include a 7-day vs 30-day comparison to highlight volatility.

Maria Onboarding: Tentative enablement slots Mon 10:30am or Tue 3pm — sending Doodle.

Arjun CS: I'll draft the risk summary and proposed mitigations. Should we include a quick calc of "savings if cache hits improve by 20%"?

Sara CSM: Yes please — that resonates with execs. Put it as a takeaway: potential $/month savings and estimated uplift to renewal odds.

Liam FinOps: Quick calc (ballpark): 20% cache hit improvement -> ~18% token cost reduction -> ~$1.8k/month saved (base). I'll formalize.

Sara CSM: Perfect. If anyone finds more surprises in the forecast, ping here. I'll assemble the QBR deck draft once slides come in. Thanks team :thumbsup:
